name: Codex Naturalis

categories.label: Score track points
categories.hint: Points from cards played (and Gold cards) on the score track; may exceed 29.

categories.label: Objective card points (2 common + 1 secret)
categories.labelVi: Điểm thẻ Mục tiêu (2 chung + 1 bí mật)
categories.hint: Add points from both common objectives and your secret objective at game end; each card in the play area counts once per objective.

tiebreakers.description: If still tied, victory is shared.

endCondition.description: A player reaching 20 points (or both decks empty) triggers the end; finish the round, then everyone plays one last turn.

notes: family: running-track-plus-objectives. Objective values are printed on cards (2 or 3 points per pattern/set), so objective points are entered as one total. Immediate points during play (resources, Gold cards) are tracked on the score track.
